headline: Law lets the Agriculture Department keep collecting and spending marina fees at Shasta-Trinity National Forest through 2029.
what_it_does: This law extends the Department of Agriculture's power to collect fees for a marina in the Shasta-Trinity National Forest in California. It also lets the department keep spending that fee money. The authority now lasts through fiscal year 2029.

who_it_affects.group: Boaters and visitors who use the marina in Shasta-Trinity National Forest
who_it_affects.how: They may continue to be charged marina fees through fiscal year 2029.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Forest Service (part of the Department of Agriculture)
who_it_affects.how: It can keep collecting and spending marina fee money for this site through fiscal year 2029.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 23, 2024; fee authority extended through fiscal year 2029.
